name: LWDED-v4
description: LWDED-v4 (Large-scale Website Defacement Evaluation Dataset) is the canonical dataset for the DI-MMGN (Dynamic Multimodal Graph Network) website defacement detection research. 1. Dataset Overview LWDED-v4 addresses the critical "reproducibility crisis" in website defacement detection by providing a frozen, fully transparent, and strictly evaluated benchmark. Unlike previous iterations, v4 enforces strict registrable-domain blocking across all splits to prevent data leakage and ensures that all four modalities are extracted via a single, pinned pipeline. Temporal Snapshot Pairs: 4,678 total pairs representing the transition from a legitimate predecessor state ($S_{t-1}$) to a current state ($S_t$). Held-out Test Protocol: 936 temporal pairs completely isolated from the training and validation processes. 2. Modality Representations Each temporal pair has been meticulously processed to support multi-modal detection approaches: DOM (Document Object Model): Encoded as structural graphs reflecting the HTML node hierarchy. Visual: Headless browser rendered screenshots processed into high-dimensional CLIP vision embeddings. Text: Extracted human-readable text contents. HTTP/Network: Status codes, headers, and transmission signals. 3. Contents of the Dataset Archive This deposition contains the pure dataset extracted features and splits: snapshot_manifest.jsonl, visual_manifest.jsonl, text_manifest.jsonl: Frozen dataset pair definitions and source-provenance records.
